project.title: Anaerobic Fludized Membrane BioReactor (AFMBR) for Greywater Treatment
project.description: A comparative study of organic matter removal efficiency, fouling control, and methane production in synthetic greywater treatment is performed using three anaerobic fluidized bed membrane bioreactors (AFMBRs). Granular activated carbon (GAC) particles, polyaniline-coated polyethylene terephthalate (PET) beads, and uncoated PET beads are added to each AFMBR.
